leave-the-names.end: Recovery work changes the next departure

the-last-monster.note: Worn equipment, scars and an old camp demonstrate elapsed time without supplying a duration. The final confession does not settle the identities, number or later fates of those below.

coiled-together.start: Less than an hour of lost awareness
coiled-together.end: One recovery night before a paid trial

the-ordinary-slime.start: A spill closed three generations earlier
the-ordinary-slime.end: Storm response and continuing repair watches

the-thirteenth-command.end: One short command session and an unsettled dawn
the-thirteenth-command.note: The lattice reorganizes existing skill while exhausting its cells. The ceasefire, narrow water release and incident record are shown; a new civilian board and lasting water settlement remain future proposals.

anatomy-of-a-god.end: A storm encounter in an occupied sanctuary
anatomy-of-a-god.note: Prior experience supplies a starting technique that must be changed for this individual body. The sanctuary's age, the earlier users of its care apparatus and its relation to other regenerator populations remain unknown.

the-mercy-circuit.end: One certified shift, with later work still due

a-little-more-room.start: A new neighbor and a borrowed record
a-little-more-room.note: The record comes back three days after the first meeting, followed by a Friday invitation and Saturday visit. The opening weekday is unstated; the sequence does not supply a civil date or a shared calendar with other stories.

rooms-before-sunrise.start: A floor molt, census error and emergency growth
rooms-before-sunrise.end: Sunrise with housing recognized and repair ongoing
rooms-before-sunrise.note: Municipal repair slips establish valid prior detachment. Mular admits three or four months of budding; Kevi says longer. That dispute remains. The final intervention starts fifty-one minutes before sunrise intake and does not complete census or lease restoration.

drone-down.start: An earlier stun and a contested bread-queue fall
drone-down.end: A later shared escape without a scored victory

the-driver-the-city-could-not-see.start: A coin fare at twelve minutes past midnight
the-driver-the-city-could-not-see.note: One night is enough to escape the city network, not to establish a new home or livelihood. Restoring the fuse would expose the missing journey; the chosen roads still require fuel, charging and decisions about registry gates.

laughing-clouds.end: Cleanup and passive signal trials that afternoon
laughing-clouds.note: The first deadline is two hours and twelve minutes away. Available charge permits one bounded demonstration and cleanup; the final optical samples do not run the pumps. Acceptance remains conditional, with no later adoption or completed redesign shown.

the-city-of-eleven-foundations.start: Weeks of heat before a basin-wide storm
the-city-of-eleven-foundations.end: Survival followed by lasting maintenance changes
the-city-of-eleven-foundations.note: The emergency uses existing contemporary districts and equipment. The river falls and the outfall becomes reachable after the city has already been saved. the-wrong-side-of-the-part.note: A six-month-old message becomes a public weapon during one afternoon's estate dispute. The accounting and appraisal still lie ahead; the requested thirty-day financing window is not agreed.

a-place-for-the-living.note: Seventy-three years separate Zephra's death from this dinner; the custom began earlier but has no fixed founding date. Greer and Imani have been together eighteen months. A living host sustains the brief visit, with about twenty minutes comfortable before mounting strain.

self-reflection.note: Anin appears and disappears across four dawns. Nina speaks to her friends at lunch the following day. This is one non-repeatable incident, not a known lifespan for a type of person.

transitions-in-common.note: One Friday-to-Monday interval contains the misunderstanding, reveal, apology and bounded continuation. Forty seconds describes a practiced change; roughly twenty minutes describes recovery before another reliable change, not the duration of a body.

life-with-a-girlfriend-with-shrinking-po.note: The first cycle lasts eight minutes; at least six hours separate safe cycles. During the second, Luz returns before the twenty-four-minute limit for shrinking below half height. the-door-knows-home.note: Earlier use leaves mechanical wear, not a stored destination. The apprentice has two hours and fourteen minutes until five; the door is collected at 4:51. Independent qualification awaits the master's inspection, and the house sale is due to complete the next day.

realms.note: One marked return window contains the crossing and theft. The following clinic treatment helps Lena but does not cure her. The stolen token's follow trail has been used; further treatment and the confrontation remain unresolved.

the-last-bus-to-briar-hill.end: An ordinary outing two weeks later
the-last-bus-to-briar-hill.note: The mother's death lies two years earlier. The night journey reaches the terminal at 06:08; the siblings' later planned outing actually occurs two weeks afterward. These are local intervals, not a placement of Route 0 within a shared portal calendar.

the-inheritance-remembers.end: The night the road becomes visible again
the-inheritance-remembers.note: The courtesy passes through generations with no fixed founding date. Rovandis's eleven years on the courier route do not date the threshold practice. The immediate rescue ends before the planned daylight cleanup.

four-crowns-in-hiding.start: A royal collapse two months earlier
four-crowns-in-hiding.note: The coup precedes the main night by two months. The coordinated response takes three hours; capture occurs near midnight and news reaches the refuges before dawn. One kingdom's fall does not date the others' founding or destroy their ongoing work.

the-kingdom-was-the-easy-part.note: The opening is six weeks after victory. Six days of games lead to the seventh-night crisis, followed by two days of door repairs and a gathering on the third evening. the-seventh-night.end: Dinner two nights after the reset
the-seventh-night.note: The curse usually allows six uncomplicated days, worsens rapidly on the seventh and resets to Thalenna's adult baseline. It does not heal ordinary injury or exhaustion. Dinner occurs two nights after the expedition reset; the tomb's age and the curse's origin remain unknown.

where-it-hurts.start: A departure planned before the fair
where-it-hurts.end: Waiting at the evening coach yard
where-it-hurts.note: The partnership has lasted four years. A room is arranged the preceding week and the ticket bought that morning, before the bout. The injury may ease over days, but no exact recovery, completed departure or reconciliation is witnessed.

the-walls-are-thick-enough.end: The first day of a six-month suspension
the-walls-are-thick-enough.note: The evening's thirty-six-minute estimate narrows as the guard round approaches. The papers cross before accreditation expires; the next morning starts a six-month legal suspension. The later hearing is not shown.

the-gentlest-terror.start: An old alliance order and a recent royal death
the-gentlest-terror.end: The accession, flood rescue and resumed convocation
the-gentlest-terror.note: The king's three-week absence is distinct from the much older institutions and dragons' lives. No global founding date is established. Injury care and House Flint's ordinary judgment remain consequences beyond the witnessed crisis.

the-rule-between-courses.note: Four-autumn-old intentions, a relationship underway since late winter and a room viewed that afternoon enter the same conversation. These local intervals do not identify a shared calendar, city or ancestry with any other modern story.

the-night-she-knew.start: Childhood fragments and years of private testing
the-night-she-knew.note: The daughter's recalled onset and her mother's earlier suspicion are different evidence. No clinical encounter establishes society's response, and the unreset wall clock is not a reliable timestamp. This family conversation neither begins public knowledge of powers nor dates the hero institutions elsewhere.

the-bat-at-the-door.start: An injured child reaches the doorstep
the-bat-at-the-door.note: Twelve days of recovery precede the storm visit. The three-minute bodily change, the kin's once-per-sunset-to-sunset limit and the optional one-year household pledge are different clocks. The story ends before the doctor's assessment, next visit or trial year's outcome.

the-wolf-in-the-mirror.start: Three weeks preparing a familiar room
the-wolf-in-the-mirror.note: The observed night does not date the curse's beginning or prove it is the first transformation. One hour and fifty-eight minutes measures the tail pursuit, not the entire changed state. Next month's revision is agreed, not yet tested, and the other changing populations have separate rules.

she-literally-has-wings.start: Years of ordinary work and mistaken assumptions
she-literally-has-wings.end: One evening of recognition and care
she-literally-has-wings.note: Ten years dates Tomas learning her clearance. Julian's reference to seven years does not explicitly date a marriage. The present evening reveals a private misunderstanding within an already inhabited public world; it establishes neither an origin for angels nor a historical opening of society to wings.

what-turned-eighteen.start: A month preparing for an expected birthday
what-turned-eighteen.end: The first evening in nine bodies
what-turned-eighteen.note: The exact birth minute dates Arlon's change locally. The hour spent preparing the roof and the subsequent storm belong to that afternoon; they do not measure a wider historical transition. Jaro's record changes precede this day, while Arlon's later official records and long-term adaptations are unshown.

captive-couples.start: A patrol and a ventilation failure at 2:13
captive-couples.note: The seventy-five-minute interval includes the trap, escape, staff rescue and transport to assessment. The forty-five-minute reserve and six-hour transit allowance are independent limits. Seventeen minutes describes an earlier episode's depth loss, not a fixed recovery time for this injury.

the-name-i-kept.start: The bridge event six months earlier
the-name-i-kept.note: Mica was seventeen at the bridge; a birthday since then is not dated. The upload and corrupted evidence have a next-morning sequence, while the present confrontation leads through dawn to broadcast. Two generations of public family work do not measure the age of the surrounding hero institutions.

connections.label: The light that reaches another sky
connections.note: The established chronology and return story continue Faris and Seyathi’s final fall, then follow ordinary light across ages of perfect zero. Their deaths remain final and no old system returns.

connections.label: One world, a later age
connections.note: The established chronology places Nell and Bash’s old-modern endpoint long before the Glass-Sea era on the same physical world. This orders that endpoint only. Ravel is also a pre-extinction material era, but its order relative to either remains unresolved.

connections.label: The world survives to the Glass Sea
connections.note: The established western-bay chronology places Solstice’s battle before the later Glass-Sea era. No common magical system or measured interval is established.

connections.label: Three afternoons later
connections.note: The Help Network opens at Northbridge on the third afternoon after the showcase, with Cassia, Drita, and Bryn building on the earlier channel compromise.

connections.label: Mutual aid before the Bay
connections.note: The supplied sequence places the Northbridge showcase and its third-afternoon continuation before the Bay. The network shows ordinary communication joining independent magical practices over months; the coronation recalls independent circles, but no organizational descent or measured interval is established.

connections.label: A crowded sky, then the Bay
connections.note: The supplied sequence places Not About That before the Bay. This reconstruction places its everyday public flight in an earlier horizon than the battle’s queen without living subjects. No shared school, cast or institutional descent is established.

connections.note: The intended reading sequence places Dress after Solstice and before Count. Its damaged post-battle institutions turn ordinary booking marks into a false survivor claim. The prisoner is not Solstice.

connections.note: The subplot’s intended reading sequence places Dress between Solstice and Count, without an established interval. The prisoner and the later museum witness are different people.

connections.note: The prose identifies the living museum witness as Solstice Evening Bell, centuries after the same Battle of the Bay. The battle and commemoration have separate event positions with that local interval retained. The museum's pre-extinction side remains editorial.

connections.label: The archmage becomes a teacher
connections.note: Voice establishes Kethra’s qualification; Lock begins with the same named archmage taking a mistreated apprentice and uses her call-link practice. The interval is not dated.

connections.label: Two experiments in government without waking rulers
connections.note: Two twelve-dragon administrations confront closely comparable failures of personal rule. Kharost retires forty-seven fabricated dead masks and builds independent watershed sleep works; Varkesh abdicates an actually divine living guise and leaves without a veto. These distinct political experiments support a proposed shared historical context. Their resemblance establishes neither borrowing nor the same dragons, state or form of divinity; mutual order remains open.

connections.label: A home is also a living body
connections.note: Agnes exposes coerced structural labor; Lirenn discovers occupied volume inside living leased rooms. The echo connects a renewed-magical craft society and a much earlier material city without asserting shared biology or building lineage.

connections.label: Who can claim a memory?
connections.note: One-use sensory fragments from retrieved objects and licensed neural extraction make distinct memory problems. The resemblance is thematic, not a shared substance or technological ancestry.

connections.label: The record beneath the monument
connections.note: A museum’s heroic reconstruction and a drowned-king interpretation meet more limited evidence. This is a reader parallel about misremembered history, not a common archive.

connections.label: Humanity becomes an inheritance
connections.note: A dinosaur surface polity and a stellar courier encounter different human legacies. No common departure, station network, or absolute order is established.

connections.label: Learning what the creatures actually do
connections.note: Route observations change how people respond to shadow beasts and throat-node-bearing creatures. The stories establish no common species, invasion, or mechanism.

connections.label: A useful organism changes the question
connections.note: Both communities must reconsider handling practices after observing effects. The slime’s material behavior does not classify the Night Harvest effect or date either settlement.

connections.label: When the ground stops being a promise
connections.note: Evacuation requires precise counts when an inhabited hand moves and when Orison loses lift. The colossus is not assigned a reactor cause; these are not the same fall.

connections.label: The past arrives in a new present
connections.note: An intact displaced village and genetically reconstructed adults confront later institutions. Actual temporal transport and reconstruction remain different processes, not one refounding event.

connections.label: A person falls outside the map
connections.note: A threshold working disrupts a public road; a networked city cannot place an unregistered passenger. The people, technologies, and causes differ, despite the shared recognition problem.

connections.label: The destination keeps its own clock
connections.note: An assignment sequence and the Ravel encounter both resist a flat timeline. Their resemblance proves neither one portal network nor that Ryo’s destinations are Ravel.

connections.label: Crossings bring obligations home
connections.note: Bearer-powered sanctuary crossings and a living market seam both impose local limits. No mechanism, underworld, or ancient route is shared by implication.

connections.label: Another person pays for the hoped-for answer
connections.note: Tamaris nearly displaces Nivra while trying to reclaim a living body; Ruth helps Sabine board a mismatched train partly to test escape for herself. Both confront the cost imposed on another person by their own hope. The relay and the afterlife station retain different mechanisms and outcomes, with no shared chronology.

connections.label: A political offer needs a person’s answer
connections.note: Royal negotiation meets the independent will of the people inside it. This is an ethical parallel between unrelated courts, not a dynasty or a continuation of Ninepin.

connections.label: What the inherited promise costs
connections.note: A solar polity and a witch’s town confront responsibilities accumulated over generations. The juxtaposition does not make promise-binding a descendant of solar fire.

connections.label: A name that can be chosen
connections.note: Different pressures around names and identity invite a joint reading. The stories do not share a name-magic rule, heroic lineage, or cast.

connections.label: One family, unequal capacities
connections.note: An elf caregiver watches human children grow; Leonor, a demigod with human limits, helps her divine siblings navigate ordinary life. Their care takes different forms in distinct societies, connecting family obligations across unequal capacities without assigning Leonor an established lifespan.

connections.label: What different communities can still explain
connections.note: A proposed long sequence contrasts Orison's working but incomplete reactor knowledge with agrarian finders who cannot interpret a launch facility. Orison's fall leaves survivors, rescue vessels and technically capable neighbors; it does not cause the other community's ignorance. The silo's builders, prior use and loss of knowledge remain unidentified.

connections.label: The city depends on what lies beneath
connections.note: A rail worker recalls older masonry carrying a city that claims a raw-stone beginning; preserving the route makes independent inspection possible but does not complete it. The eleven-district city demonstrably shares hydraulic loads during its flood. This thematic comparison establishes no common origin, historical layers or later public acceptance of the worker's claim.

connections.label: What a community sees in a body
connections.note: Cody hides shapeshifting while another community treats varied wings as ordinary. The comparison concerns recognition, not a proven change from secrecy to openness: private concealment could exist beside public powers. It does not date these stories or connect their species.

connections.label: A profession reaching beyond the city
connections.note: Proposed regional connection: Lanternscrape receives three qualified surveyors with distinct instruments, while the municipal licensing story tests practice against pipe loads and source limits. These are compatible city-and-periphery conditions for circulating technical skills. A shared professional culture is plausible; the same guild, licensing law or exact date is not established.

connections.label: From taught flight to an inhabited sky
connections.note: Proposed long development: Nine Eaves already teaches roof-level flight and survey work using several kinds of focus; the later public sky uses diverse living flight in deliveries, family instruction and agricultural weather. The bridge is the spread of practical aerial knowledge through teaching and work, not a common power source or proof that one academy founded that city.

connections.label: Dragon service beyond hereditary alliance
connections.note: Proposed change in regional political economy: noble-dragon agreements exchange watch, rescue, nesting care and water access, while Qarsis hires a voluntarily migrant ice dragon for bounded municipal work among condensers and trade routes. The comparison supports a later reach where some dragon services travel as paid expertise. It does not claim all alliances ended or that Urumet descends from the earlier partners.

connections.label: Who controls the living heat?
connections.note: Proposed technical connection: Vantress combines living shadow, mineral heat, ceramic braces and ordinary pressure signals; the Glass-Sea branches combine dusk, living solar fire and physical heat-and-water conduits. Methods for sharing loads and limiting a capital’s draw could circulate between such societies. This proposes a field of civic engineering, not identical magic, named teachers or a proven order between the two regions.

connections.label: A family object in another age
connections.note: Tilda's nonliving focus and Lustre's living memories enter family life in different proposed ages. Their incomplete provenance is a comparison, not a common craft tradition, maker or inheritance of power.

connections.label: The licensed trades reach the threshold
connections.note: The earlier municipal assessment and later proposed doorway trade both require demonstrated work. The apprentice's independent qualification still awaits inspection. This chosen long sequence treats professional qualification as a recurring institution, not evidence that a particular guild or magical system survived every intervening age.

connections.label: Teaching extraordinary work
connections.note: Field practice, technical instruction and professional expectations connect an old collegium with a later modern college in this reconstruction. Their capacities and institutions remain different; no school descent or inherited flight system is established.

connections.label: A body can outlast its public explanation
connections.note: This proposed sequence compares routine bodily revision in an operating clinical economy with a much later village that moralizes freight adaptations. The caravan still has an anatomical survey and recognizes nutritional costs: knowledge survives unevenly. The comparison does not establish that seedglass changes produced inherited freight bodies, or identify any common population or industry.

connections.label: Living districts need a common city
connections.note: The reef tower and basin city depend on shared flow across occupied spaces. In one, improvised housing sustains excluded residents while endangering others; in the other, local protective boundaries magnify a common flood. The proposed nearby placement concerns established working infrastructure, without identifying their biology, builders, government or location.

connections.label: The political reach of orbital machinery
connections.note: Merneith's water and weather systems make political departure costly. Another government's armed platform becomes leverage over detention and court access. Physical control affects public authority at different territorial scales; a shared state or supply network is not established.

connections.label: Fresh replies on older roads
connections.note: These are separate events in the proposed older modern reach. Briar Hill needs a freely given outside reply made after entry; the Counted Road uses fresh paint and current responses to keep a count. Their practical comparison supports a nearby broad placement without establishing a common town, operator, system or measured mutual order.

connections.label: Royal power depends on paid public work
connections.note: Across two proposed old-magical ages, Sigrun's compact and Tareya's separate bargain make royal authority depend on work, supply and payment beyond the ruler. This comparison establishes no mutual order, common crown, law or institutional lineage; the selected event positions remain separate from the recurrence.

connections.label: Human builders remember magic’s death
connections.note: Orison’s school mosaic credits human builders after magic died. This reconstruction identifies that remembered break with the established extinction while leaving the intervening duration and reliability of the founding image open. The later reactor failure is a separate local technical catastrophe.

connections.label: Civilian work beside the military sky
connections.note: A ruined military foundry's active archive and paid tug crews occupy a proposed overlapping technical reach. Both use embodied neural systems under material limits. A shared trading network, military history or manufacturer is not established.

connections.label: From secret contacts to an ordinary public sky
connections.note: Northbridge's helpers prevent public exposure in a city that treats magic as fiction; their private network then grows internationally. Lowen's city openly uses flight for deliveries, weather and family practice. This contrast motivates a substantial proposed historical separation. The change in public knowledge is unknown, and the Help Network is not established as the origin of later schools or circles.

connections.label: Who is allowed to learn, and who is made useful?
connections.note: Public schools distinguish access to magical education from bodily appearance, while Brightward makes a student's capacity available to institutional demands. Their explicit systems of training and eligibility support a shared proposed public culture. They have different schools and capacities, with no common admissions rule established.

connections.label: A familiar body can still be misread
connections.note: Delsie's laboratory-made appearance does not make her magical; Coralie's wings do not tell her husband what kind of person she is. Public familiarity with several bodily origins can recur across the extinction while classifications still fail individuals. No surviving species, laboratory or power is implied.

connections.label: What a city asks of its heroes
connections.note: Brackenport excludes hero organizations because their conflicts consume ordinary civic life. Held Together depicts the care, utilities and medical systems that organized hero work needs. The later recurrence reopens a political problem from inside the profession; it does not inherit Warren's agencies or powers.

connections.label: The person behind the usable power
connections.note: Brightward treats Mirelle's capacity as institutional equipment; the Serrin family makes Mica and Auden carry its public identity. Across distinct magical ages, people must recover control over abilities others treat as resources. Neither an organization nor a power survives by this comparison.

connections.label: When ordinary explanations leave no place for you
connections.note: Northbridge's aliases protect help in a city skeptical of real magic. In The Night She Knew, medical misclassification is the mother's fear; the story does not demonstrate the wider society's response. The comparison concerns trust within different relationships, not a repeated worldwide stage of ignorance or a secret organization surviving the Long Dark.

connections.label: A profession needs care and accountability
connections.note: Patrol work, power-informed medicine, operational records and institutional responsibility support a proposed professional context for both stories. The family team in The Name I Kept spans two shown generations; it does not date the profession's origin. The agencies, incidents and their mutual order remain distinct and unresolved.

connections.label: Power works inside an organization
connections.note: Patrol infrastructure and medical support in Held Together have a compatible professional setting in the harnesses, displays and municipal defense of A Very Good Dog. Their powers and equipment need not share a source for these public-service economies to be historical neighbors.

connections.label: When a society expects your body to answer
connections.note: Arlon's community expects a change at eighteen; another population expects a faculty-bearing mark at birth and offers grafts. Their different life-course institutions put social expectations around uncertain bodies. This compares the pressures on people, without deriving one population or mechanism from the other.

connections.label: Treaty claims recur under different empires
connections.note: Tareya negotiates separate marriage, jurisdiction and aid terms; in a different proposed age, Tazri invokes an older treaty against an emperor's seizure of her levy. Their comparison does not establish common courts, law or institutional survival across extinction. One bargain succeeds; the other buys a contested suspension.

connections.label: What returning cannot give back
connections.note: Four exiled sisters learn to live as guests of independent sanctuary communities. In a later proposed dynastic world, Clarimond's restored capital cannot return the childhood or the caregiver's intervening life she lost. The comparison gives royal restoration a human cost; it establishes no common house or exile.

connections.label: The people beyond the inherited story
connections.note: A five-century closed pass hides an ordinary orc city from human scouts; an orbital account of surface failure hides people who can still answer in an old script. The simultaneous living populations support a proposed shared reach of divided knowledge. Their barriers, histories and peoples have different causes and no common state.

connections.label: The person outside the official record
connections.note: In one proposed age, a living tower's residents survive in space omitted from municipal records. In a later city, an android travels outside the managed identity system. Official recognition has different material effects in each story; their biology, software and governments are not identified.

connections.label: Skilled care travels with the roads
connections.note: Proposed regional affinity: a chapterhouse's sponsored training feeds road rotations, while the House of Common Shelter moves its workers through seasonal postings. Both require an inhabited road network and support for traveling practitioners. No shared order, curriculum or appointment calendar is established.

connections.label: The official hero misses who did the work
connections.note: Nemea's rules exclude a witness from the deed, but she fights; an army's victory stories appropriate a bird defending people across its banners. Official heroic accounts can misdescribe visible work through different institutions. Neither establishes a common council, campaign or sequence.

connections.label: A lived capacity outruns its description
connections.note: Rasden changes what self-mending practice preserves; Pelmara develops a different capacity after an old gift is withdrawn. Repetition and bodily experience expose incomplete descriptions in distinct ways. Cultivated is provisional terminology for Pelmara's case, not a diagnosis imposed on Rasden.

connections.label: Freedom after military use
connections.note: Anvek chooses to use retained combat capacities after technicians have severed remote coercion. Loxan is still pursued through a working recovery system. These are different histories of individual freedom, without an established shared war or liberation movement.

connections.label: The sky has other inhabitants
connections.note: A Jovian watch follows an organism's response to pressure; a sunshade crew follows nesting animals' responses to movement. Human settlements depend on maintenance that accounts for existing life. The species, builders and control systems have separate, unresolved histories.

connections.label: Living powers in working harbors
connections.note: Both ports sustain launches and passage through crews, maintained routes and bounded relationships with living powers. Brackwater renews an established two-god truce; Mallowbreak contains a temporary divine office through evacuation and physical relief works. Their proposed maritime context establishes no shared port, ritual ancestry or mutual order.

connections.label: Shared service, separate allegiances
connections.note: The Brackwater priests maintain passage without converting each other. Vantress's rulers establish a one-moon service compact with separate safety vetoes, keeping courtship distinct from public duty. These are different arrangements for working together; no treaty descent or common divine law is established.

connections.label: The terms of a promised future
connections.note: Sablewake's living readers enforce a witnessed future, leaving the city without redundancy. In the Long Dark, a new climate archive offers eighteen-hour forecasts in exchange for an authorized route song carrying unproved historical blame. The comparison concerns the terms of reliance, not shared machinery, compulsion or institutional descent.

connections.label: Courtship makes room for an existing career
connections.note: Fiora's supper leaves her teaching move intact. Beatriz sets a date after the showcase and her first paid weekend. These distinct professional lives give courtship practical limits without connecting the institutions or establishing an order between the stories.

connections.label: Learning a person beyond familiar habits
connections.note: Ceret must hear how her friends' lives have changed. At Hinge, observed routines and purchase histories give way to what people choose to disclose. Their shared concern is the work of knowing someone over time; no common town, population history or personal connection is established.

connections.label: The person behind an authorization
connections.note: Adrian uses ordinary witnessed records to preserve his consent after a decade of family concealment. Elspeth confronts forged orders and a continuity rule that discredits her real voice. Both expose how household authority can detach an official account from the person it names, through different institutions and without a shared mechanism or lineage.

connections.label: The evidence a name can carry
connections.note: A newly made Lion cane prompts testimony from a living survivor. Cerdovan's original strips physically authorize an engine and preserve civic context. Neither recovery restores everything that was lost; the objects retain distinct functions with no shared naming power, law or lineage.

connections.label: Watersheds kept working
connections.note: These waterworks share a proposed regional horizon of continuing maintenance and contested water use. One combines a biological indicator with gauges; Copperwell corrects old telemetry through current reports and physical coordination. No common river, state, builders or relative order is established.

connections.label: Warnings heard through fear
connections.note: Salken mistakes evacuation signals for a hunt. The outrider and cousin misread a constrained rescue and broken speech, while a rope carrier distinguishes what was actually witnessed. Each place has limited local signals; neither establishes a common language, people or history.

connections.label: Artificial people, different claims on a life
connections.note: Suzette has an apartment, preferences and bounded filters; Arovi is a municipal android escaping threatened rollback in a later proposed city. Artificial people recur under different arrangements. Neither a common manufacturer nor a history of emancipation, reform or later loss of rights is established.

connections.label: A working device still needs a bounded use
connections.note: Paid salvage repair and a civic festival both depend on skilled testing, limited resources and human decisions about safe use. A one-shift certificate and one conditional demonstration preserve different local limits. The proposed workshop context does not establish a common regulator or make either machine able to recognize a person's wishes.

connections.label: Appraisal recurs in another age
connections.note: A salon and a doorway bring family property into specialist appraisal in different proposed ages. Equal shares, incomplete accounts and the holder's choices remain distinct from a working's behavior. No common law, city or institutional survival is established.

connections.label: A present reply crosses the boundary
connections.note: Briar's travelers need a fresh, freely given answer from outside. Cleo must remake contact for a particular sleeping neighbor, with her own play and limits intact. The living intermediaries perform different tasks; this comparison establishes no common dream route, portal, power or historical order.

historyThreads.title: Gods and authority
historyThreads.description: Local crowns, divine offices and technical states repeatedly gain and lose authority; the extinction alone ends every old material magical capacity.

stages.title: A crown meets another will
stages.note: Ersene's existing alliances distribute watch, rescue, nesting care and watershed work between freely choosing partners. Another court bargains over marriage and service. These institutions already have histories; they establish neither one original monarchy nor a common dragon or divine lineage.

stages.title: Authority is shared, inherited or surrendered
stages.note: Abdication ends the Sleepless Majesty's godhood, harbor priests preserve distinct divine jurisdictions, and a child accepts a bounded regency. These political changes have different local consequences while magic remains active.

stages.title: Institutions across the extinction
stages.note: Ninepin's proposed late-old campaign depends on depots and public offices while a ruler's personal magic remains active. The terminal extinction later ends all old material magical capacity. A separate House society exercises authority through ordinary records and inherited status during the proposed zero-era reach; it is not established as Ninepin's successor.

stages.title: Power is built in matter
stages.note: Perfect zero leaves rulers dependent on material institutions. Merneith's utilities support an empire, while a different state's armed platform and courts become the instruments of a local confrontation. Ancient royal identities supply public meaning without restored minds or divine power.

stages.title: Command destroys a connection
stages.note: The First People destroy the fast network rather than surrender it; surviving civilizations undertake slower relief. Much later, the new magical link requires living replies. The injured vessel's rescue has no established relationship to the burn.

stages.title: Gods live among obligations
stages.note: Divine households and water kingdoms recur in the new-magical world with local debts, subjects and limits of their own.

stages.title: Divinity meets practical work
stages.note: A later royal service bureaucracy can delay work despite a living fairy's protections. A bounded death god participates in civic labor, while a practitioner examines an older sanctuary's claim to godhood. These are distinct institutions with local capabilities, not evidence of one restored old order.

historyThreads.title: Technology and public works
historyThreads.description: Working infrastructure survives some political changes, fails locally in others, and is repeatedly maintained, lost, repurposed or rebuilt.

stages.title: Skills circulate between settlements
stages.note: Visiting surveyors meet village knowledge; schools and itinerant appointments sustain professional work beyond the town. Mechanical maintenance remains necessary alongside living capacities, and collective harvest works have local uses that military pursuit can disrupt.

stages.title: Cities rework inherited systems
stages.note: Separate watershed works free a public water system from the royal sleep basin. In the proposed later reach, the Glass Sea decentralizes its damaged solar inheritance and Vantress develops a shared service compact. Each change depends on technical crews and specific limits on control.

stages.title: Human works rise and fail
stages.note: Later old-magical services precede extinction. Separate human courts, working cities and maritime systems then operate during the zero; Orison's grounding is one local loss before the proposed encounter with an unrecognized arsenal.

stages.title: Capacity and control diverge
stages.note: Routine bodily revision, living housing, shared district repair and civilian orbital work coexist with institutions that restrict access. Technological sophistication does not give these societies one politics.

stages.title: Knowledge survives in different hands
stages.note: Inherited mine works and distinct regional relays still need skilled operators. Other communities lack accounts that capable cities, caravans or orbital neighbors retain. The First People's destruction of the fast stellar roads is a separate explicit rupture.

stages.title: New powers enter inhabited services
stages.note: Modern emergency care and public hero work coexist with agricultural and mobile water societies after return; new magic does not require everyone to rebuild the same way.

stages.title: Craft and advanced tools coexist
stages.note: Municipal engines and a restored hall remain useful beside highly mechanized excavation. Later technical cultures retain different capacities rather than occupying one final rung.

historyThreads.title: Bodies and public powers
historyThreads.description: Inhabited bodies carry distinct biological, technical and magical histories; public roles recur without preserving an extinct magical root.

stages.title: Public powers acquire competing duties
stages.note: Village work, recognized crafts and public heroism give capacities different social roles. Councils may suppress a partner's contribution; a court's protective armor may transfer danger; private practice may produce a freely chosen rescue. These older public forms precede the proposed low-magic trough and the later public sky without establishing a single institutional lineage.

stages.title: Hidden aid and a later public sky
stages.note: Northbridge's secret international help precedes a proposed later reach of public teaching and aerial work. Solstice's circles eventually vanish on their own history; the Bay does not end all extraordinary institutions.

stages.title: Old capacities reach zero
stages.note: Individual old abilities are embedded in ordinary work before extinction. All Accounts Due then ends old magical function while preserving what ordinary matter can sustain; no dormant power remains to lift Orison.

stages.title: Who controls a technical body?
stages.note: Routine body plans and home repair make technology personal; housing records and military commands can turn that capacity into control. Anvek has already escaped involuntary command while Loxan is still pursued. Different settlements of bodily authority overlap.

stages.title: A population outlives its explanation
stages.note: A village calls inherited strength virtue while a caravan recognizes anatomy and nutritional costs. Surface peoples also exceed old orbital classifications. New magic eventually adds a capacity without explaining or replacing these populations.

stages.title: Public familiarity and private knowledge differ
stages.note: Specialist care and public professions can coexist with intimate secrecy and misclassification. Coralie's neighbors know ordinary life with wings yet misread her, while a hero family controls a public record. The expected birthday change belongs to another local custom. These differences supply no universal progression or ancestry.

stages.title: Care meets inherited expectations
stages.note: Long memories and borrowed bodies require practical care. Elsewhere, expected birth marks and access to grafts make bodily identity a family and occupational pressure. These cultures develop different relationships between capacity and choice.

historyThreads.title: Memory and landscape
historyThreads.description: The same physical world repeatedly outlasts its accounts of itself: roads, bodies, ruins, records and living witnesses preserve different portions of the past.

stages.title: The older world is already layered
stages.note: An isolated wizard recalls old imperial networks without knowing their present reach; paid explorers find traces of earlier visitors. The older world already contains uneven histories, and Nell's brief departure opens onto another unresolved material era.

stages.title: Land and witnesses outlast regimes
stages.note: Royal land becomes woodland, a living witness corrects centuries of Bay commemoration, and recovered records change how the Glass Sea governs its surviving branches.

stages.title: History becomes working knowledge
stages.note: Orison makes magic's death a founding image. A sailing city gains forecasts by authorizing a disputed inherited account. Agrarian finders elsewhere cannot interpret a silo. Practical usefulness, accepted history and surviving understanding diverge within this proposed reach.

stages.title: Antiquity is reconstructed
stages.note: Merneith builds a new empire through a reconstruction of ancient identity and contemporary technical systems. Her tomb's ten-thousand-year interval and later sixty-year rise remain local spans; they do not date every material civilization.

stages.title: Inherited histories hide contemporaries
stages.note: Obsolete maps and inherited political accounts conceal living neighbors. Elsewhere, a worker's preserved route challenges a city's founding story but still requires physical inspection. Ancient human records establish a different stellar inheritance.

stages.title: Living communities keep different histories
stages.note: A century-old photograph carries a town's obligations into present life. On another coast, route traditions and physical repairs challenge a royal interpretation without yielding a complete ancient history. A later proposed Crucible catastrophe has its own regional consequences; none of these accounts establishes one shared disaster or archive.

stages.title: Old lives meet later institutions
stages.note: Kettlebridge's transported inhabitants confront a founding identity assigned by later institutions; the supposed family descent is unproven. Elsewhere, an ancient client's memory has limits that present expertise cannot erase. These encounters preserve different relationships between elapsed history and lived experience.
